credits.title: Chicken Boy
credits.overview: Boris pursues masculinity and self-confidence through the teachings of social media guru Marcus Zain. But after a disastrous birthday party exposes his place within his friend group, bullying and his inner demons push him toward a monstrous transformation.

credits.title: Nazi Supersoldier
credits.overview: A group of journalism students ventures into a remote forest and awakens a long-frozen World War II experiment a superhuman Nazi soldier. Hunted through cursed woods where trust crumbles and survival is slim, they soon learn that some sins demand blood.

credits.title: Rou
credits.overview: 200 years after a nuclear war destroyed the modern world, the island of Revent is ruled by a totalitarian government. The film follows a man who tries to escape the island in search of freedom, and what he discovers along the way.
